channel.title: Best Little Sites - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: WONDER MAN's Audience Score Revealed Along With Full Look At "Wonder Man" Costume
item.description: An "Audience Score" for Wonder Man has been generated on Rotten Tomatoes, while we also have a first look at the full superhero costume worn by Simon Williams in the "Wonder Man" movie.

item.title: Chris Pine Offers Candid Update On His STAR TREK Future As Franchise Charts A New Course
item.description: Chris Pine, who brought James T. Kirk to modern audiences, shared a candid update on his future with Star Trek, hinting at a new direction for the franchise and offering advice to Paramount’s leadership.

item.title: Will There Be A WONDER MAN Season 2? Showrunner Shares Possible Story Plans
item.description: Wonder Man showrunner Andrew Guest has discussed a possible Season 2 and reveals what direction he'd be looking to take Simon Williams' story in. SPOILERS follow.

item.title: Jason Momoa Opens Up About Finally Playing Lobo In SUPERGIRL
item.description: Jason Momoa has been at the top of many fans’ wish lists to play Lobo for years, though his journey took an unexpected detour when he first suited up as Aquaman in Zack Snyder’s DCEU.

item.title: JUSTICE LEAGUE Star Henry Cavill Shares First Look At HIGHLANDER Reboot
item.description: Man of Steel star Henry Cavill has shared two first-look photos from Chad Stahelski's Highlander reboot, revealing his take on Connor MacLeod, a role previously filled by Christopher Lambert.

item.title: James Gunn Ends Robert Pattinson, Grant Gustin DCU Speculation; Defends Writer Christina Hodson
item.description: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has put an end to the speculation about Robert Pattinson and Grant Gustin joining the DCU, and defends rumoured The Brave and the Bold writer Christina Hodson.

item.title: REBORN: ULTIMATE IMPACT Comic Will Reveal The Ultimate Universe's Impact On Earth-616
item.description: This May, we'll feel the fallout from the end of the Ultimate Universe in Reborn: Ultimate Impact, a five-issue saga by Chris Condon and Stefano Caselli, and a first look has been revealed.

item.title: WONDER MAN Spoilers: 5 Ways Marvel's Latest Series Sets Up The MCU's Future
item.description: Marvel Television's Wonder Man is now streaming on Disney+, and we're taking a closer look at the ways this series ties into and sets up the MCU's future. SPOILERS follow!
